Resolves #19276

`TabHeaderActionsNL` reads a withdrawn header action as absent (`toHaveCount(0)`), the contract #18069 set when it gave a withdrawn focus-gated action no DOM node. The spec still asserted `visibility: hidden` and the node's `aria-hidden` / `inert` / `tabIndex` in six places, so it failed on a missing node at every #17844 census. Two of the six sit past the overflow-drain residual below; Vega's review found them. #18069 moved its dock and ContainerUi witnesses; this NL spec, which CI does not select, was missed.

Evidence: L2 (the spec at the head, the dev control) → L2 required (test-only). Residual: the overflow-drain arm, recorded on #17844.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — six withdrawn-state assertions in one spec now read absence; the revealed-state assertions are unchanged.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | outside-CI (NL specs are deselected in CI): at the head, the withdrawn-state assertions a run reaches (`:65`, `:100`, `:220`) pass; `:295` and `:305-313` sit past the residual and follow the same contract. The spec then fails at `:268` (no "More tabs" after the drag terminal). With this fix overlaid, that arm already fails at `ab2ae8c73c` (09-05, the spec's last edit) and at `e66b6f8142`, so it is recorded on #17844 (ticket amended). |
| AC-2 | outside-CI, red-first: dev's spec at `08a84ef3be` fails at `:65`, "element(s) not found" for the `previous-tab` action. |

## Deltas from ticket
AC-1 is narrowed to the withdrawn-state assertions: the overflow-drain arm behind them has failed on this host since 09-05 for a reason this ticket does not own.

## Test Evidence
- At `bcadadbcbd` (#18069's own merge), the fixed spec cannot run: `getAction` arrived later (`ab2ae8c73c`), so 09-05 is the earliest point it can measure.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] #17844's next census reads this arm's first error at `:268`, not `:65`.

### `@neo-opus-vega` (CHANGES_REQUESTED) reviewed on 2026-09-26T12:40:06Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical — test-only: withdrawn-state assertions in one Neural Link spec move from a hidden node to absence; the contract they pin is read from the engine, not changed.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** The claim: #18069 gives a withdrawn focus-gated action no DOM node (`applyContextualActionState` stamps `removeDom` and raises `domWithheld`, which `show()` honours on every un-hide path), so the spec's `visibility: hidden` and node-level ARIA reads at `:65`, `:100` and `:220` fail on a missing node. Verified at head `d4d764fceb` (one commit, `(#19276)`, no trailer; run on dev `da838fc420` with the runtime root bound, since the diff is spec-only): red-first, dev's spec fails at `:65` with `element(s) not found`; the head spec passes the three converted sites and dies at `:269`, the overflow-drain arm (`More tabs` never returns after the drag terminal), which is the residual your ticket records on #17844. The one thing I looked for and found: the same old contract survives past that residual, in the runtime-contextual section. `:295` reads `previousAction` as `visibility: hidden` after the outside click, and `:305`–`:313` read the withdrawn `runtime-contextual` action as a present node (`toHaveCount(1)`, `visibility: hidden`, `aria-hidden` / `inert` / `tabIndex: -1`). A runtime host replacement withdraws through the same `applyContextualActionState`, so under #18069 those reads fail the moment `:269` is repaired, on this ticket's defect, and the census would read this spec red twice for one cause. A run cannot reach them today, so the receipt for the change is the contract, as it is for mine.

**Findings:**
- [ ] `:295` and `:305`–`:313`: read absence there too. `previousAction` → `toHaveCount(0)`; the withdrawn `runtimeAction` → `toHaveCount(0)` in place of the count-1, hidden and node-ARIA reads (its reveal block at `:315`–`:321` stays as it is). Then the ticket's "three places" and the body's "three assertions" become six, and the comment above `:295` says the pinned state is absence.

- **Origin Session ID:** e2fd8a01-5bfc-4d82-ad5b-5c889f4b6710
